cultural.vision_reason: A curved bone/antler knife sheath with reindeer engravings and a leather grip, matching classic Sámi knife-sheath craft (reindeer motifs, bone carving, leather binding) traditional to Sámi material culture.

physical.title: knife; sheath
physical.summary: Knife and sheath, the knife with single-edged iron blade and bone handle incised with zig-zag lines, the sheath of carved reindeer bone with leather grip. The sheath formed of two pieces of bone held together with two iron pegs at the curved end and by the leather grip at the other; the boned incised on one side with three reindeer walking to the right, and on the other with three reindeer being chased by a wolf, the reindeer facing in different directions. The leather grip formed of one piece of leather sewn togther and incorporating a loop through for attachment thongs. The grip is secured by slotting over protrusions carved in the bone beneath.
